# Leticia Braiding Hair LLC

> Hair braiding studio based in Austin, Texas. Knotless and box braids, boho curls, feed-ins, Fulani, cornrows, twists and locs on W 28th St in West Campus. Text a photo of the look you want and ask about same-day openings.

- Phone: (737) 264-2705
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, West Lake Hills, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 5.0 from 60 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/leticia-braiding-hair-llc/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/leticia-braiding-hair-llc/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Small, medium and large knotless or classic box braids with neat, even parts.
- Boho & goddess braids: Braids with soft curly pieces left loose, in black, honey, copper or blonde.
- Feed-ins, Fulani & lemonade: Sleek feed-in braids, Fulani patterns and side-swept lemonade braids.
- Cornrows & kids braids: Straight-backs and curved cornrow designs, for grown-ups and kids.
- Twists, crochet & faux locs: Two-strand, passion and Senegalese twists, crochet styles and faux locs.
- Locs & sew-ins: Loc retwists and maintenance, starter locs, loc extensions and sew-ins.

## About
Leticia Braiding Hair works out of Suite 104A at 600 W 28th St, in West Campus a few blocks from UT Austin. The studio has a black wood-grain ceiling, black chairs with brass arms, ivy above the mirrors, and white walls hand-painted with black, grey and gold brush strokes. What clients talk about most is how calm and clean it feels, and how fast and careful the work is. Text her a picture of the look you want and she will match it, adjust the parts the way you like, and often fit you in the same day. There are snacks and drinks while you sit. Her menu runs from cornrows, kids braids and feed-ins to knotless, Fulani, lemonade and goddess braids, twists and crochet, faux locs, starter locs, loc retwists and sew-ins, with starting prices posted up front.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Open seven days. Monday and Tuesday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Wednesday to Sunday 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call (737) 264-2705 if you're not sure.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: Suite 104A at 600 W 28th St, Austin, TX 78705, in West Campus a few blocks from the UT Austin campus.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Prices are on the Styles and prices list. A few examples: cornrows from $120, knotless braids from $140, box braids from $150, feed-in braids from $150 and loc retwists from $80. Length, size and hair can change the total, so send a photo for an exact price.
- Q: Can I get in today?
  A: Often, yes. Clients have called last minute and been in the chair within the hour. Call or text (737) 264-2705 to check today's openings.
- Q: Do you provide the hair?
  A: Yes, on request. Mention it when you book so the right hair is ready for your style.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Text a photo of the style you want to (737) 264-2705, call, book a time on Booksy, or send a request on this site.
- Q: How long do braids take?
  A: Most styles take two to five hours. Large knotless braids are listed at about 3 hours 15 minutes, medium knotless about 4 hours 30 minutes, and cornrows about 2 hours 15 minutes. One client with very thick, long hair had medium box braids done in around four hours.
